title: Tracing Stereotypes in Pre-trained Transformers: From Biased Neurons to Fairer Models

bias_targets.methodology: Transforming stereotypes from the CrowS-Pairs dataset into cloze-style bias-activating prompts, tracing responsible neurons using Integrated Gradients, and measuring model perplexity changes after suppressing these neurons.
